race.comment: GALANT KNIGHT (1) has the best winning profile after resuming with a strong BM56 win at Kyneton, coming from well back to beat Brutify, and his overall record of two wins from three starts gives him more upside than most of these. The rise to 1600m looks to suit and he can go on with it. RICHO (9) was dominant, winning a Mdn by six lengths at Pakenham Synthetic and is lightly raced enough to improve again. Have to respect greatly. ISLAND BOY (5) brings the most established mile form, having just missed at Cranbourne and owning two wins at the distance, he'll be running on strongly. EN FLIQUE (2) has been plain in two runs back, but she is third-up now and can be an improver.
